# Pitch Outline

One block per scoring criterion. Time per block roughly follows weight. Fill time limit once known [GAP C10].

1. **Problem** (short) – driver arrives, bay taken or blocked. CPO loses trust and revenue.
2. **Live demo – Technical Implementation (30%)** – full cycle S1, then one edge case (S3, S4 or S7). Fallback: video.
3. **Solution Concept & Innovation (20%)** – our mission-area answers; creative plate use; new use cases slide.
4. **Business Case & CPO Value (20%)** – who pays, pricing, KPIs (assumptions labelled).
5. **Interoperability & Scalability (15%)** – open API, OCPP/OCPI mapping, app A ↔ app B, other sites.
6. **Documentation (15%)** – what is documented, what did not work, limitations.
7. **Close** – one sentence on value, team, ask.
